name: Global Gold Mining Limited
summary: Global Gold Mining Limited engages in the gold exploration in Slovakia, United Kingdom, and Slovakia. It explores for silver and gold equivalents. The company's flagship property is the Sturec Gold project that covers 9.47 square kilometers located in Central Slovakia. The company was formerly known as MetalsTech Ltd. and changed its name to Global Gold Mining Limited in August 2026. Global Gold Mining Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Osborne Park, Australia.
